title: From Ambiguity to a Working Product
subtitle: Selected work across interface craft, founder-led exploration and systems that make products easier to ship

cv.note: Tailored for the B2B UI/UX & Brand Designer role

bio.short: I’m a product and design leader with 15+ years turning ambiguous B2B opportunities into products people can use and teams can ship. I work from research and strategy through interface design, real-code prototypes and scalable design systems. Recent work includes founder-led AI onboarding, a two-month platform launch and a multi-platform visual language that external engineers are now implementing.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV, I combine product strategy, interface design and real-code prototyping across web, Android, iOS and connected TV. The current redesign translates the 2025 broadcast rebrand into a warm, premium product language. Underneath it sit a production colour engine and platform-agnostic token API; external engineers review and ship from my prototype code.

In 2025 I returned to Ninox as an independent consultant for a founder-led AI onboarding project. I worked directly with the CEO and technical co-founder before product-team handoff. I designed a prompt-to-database flow in which chat and the real data-model editor remain usable side by side. The AI gets a non-expert past the blank screen without taking ownership of the resulting product away from them.

At ChurchDesk, I turned a fixed funeral-booking brief into a reusable platform capability by extending the existing calendar and form builder. I held product management and design together through a two-month development release. The launch customer saw 70% less coordination time and 90% booking acceptance, and the capability then shipped across the customer base for additional booking workflows.

context.emphasis: Lead with current zero-to-one product building and interface craft, then show founder collaboration, measurable B2B delivery and design systems that scale implementation. Use brand translation and product visual language as the honest brand proof.
